# pulse_object_bucket (Resource)

A JetStream object store bucket, for files and large payloads. (Event payloads above 1 MiB go to Pulse's own `blobs` bucket, which is managed by pulsed and cannot be managed here.) Deleting the resource deletes the bucket and every object. Import with the bucket name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Camera snapshots, kept for a week and at most 10 GiB.
resource "pulse_object_bucket" "snapshots" {
  name        = "camera-snapshots"
  description = "Doorbell camera snapshots"
  ttl_seconds = 604800
  max_bytes   = 10737418240
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name: letters, digits, `_` and `-`, at most 64. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `max_bytes` (Number) Size limit in bytes; `-1` (the default) is unlimited.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) How long objects are kept, in seconds; `0` (the default) keeps them forever.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Bucket name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pulse_object_bucket.snapshots camera-snapshots
```
